title: Rock socket inspection.
officialText: Caisson rock sockets shall be subject to special inspection in accordance with Section 1704.9. All caisson rock sockets shall be inspected to verify rock quality. Inspection may be accomplished by direct observation, by video methods or by a core boring performed prior to the drilling of the socket.
